item.text: Every PR runs the selected mocked E2E integrations (GitHub, Gmail, Google Calendar/Docs/Drive/Sheets/Slides, Slack, Exa web-access, web-app/browser push); only direct OpenAI API-key live smoke runs weekly/manually, other providers remain compile-only, native-memory contracts remain temporarily, and Telegram/Notion MCP/NearAI MCP/Mem0 live lanes are omitted.
